content.text:
```pycon
deliverable:
  artifact: single self-contained .html
  assets: inline base64 raster only (matplotlib->PIL, pnginfo=None)
  forbidden_chart_libs:
  - plotly
  - altair
  - bokeh
  - echarts
  - any lib that serializes rows into the file
  audience: non-technical; offline double-click; screen + print
  language: <TBD>
binding_slots:
  amount_col: null
  date_col: null
  count_col: null
  dims: []
  suppressed: []
sections:
- id: cover
  block: title + date range + one-line purpose
  metrics: []
  chart: null
  note: no 'prepared by' personal name (metadata leak)
- id: headline
  block: KPI band, 3-5 tiles
  metrics:
  - total amount
  - order count
  - avg order value
  - <optional> repeat-purchase rate
  chart: null
  note: whole numbers; currency rounded
- id: trend
  block: period-over-period movement
  metrics:
  - amount by month
  - order count by month
  chart: line or column; single series; no data labels
  note: truncate partial first/last period or flag it
- id: composition
  block: where the value sits
  metrics:
  - amount share by <dim_1>
  chart: horizontal bar, sorted desc, top N + 'other'
  note: N<=8; suppress cells < threshold
- id: comparison
  block: one vs one, no more
  metrics:
  - amount by <dim_1> x <dim_2> (2x2/3x3 max)
  chart: grouped bar OR small-multiple panels
  note: cap cells; merged 'other' bucket
- id: dispersion
  block: shape of the distribution, not individuals
  metrics:
  - quantiles of amount per order (p10/50/90)
  chart: box or violin by <dim_1>
  note: drop outliers from axis only, never from calc
- id: notes
  block: method + privacy statement, plain language
  metrics: []
  chart: null
  note: state grain, date range, min-cell threshold, rounding
privacy_controls:
  min_cell_threshold: 5
  drop_before_aggregate:
  - names
  - emails
  - phones
  - addresses
  - ip
  - customer_id
  - account_no
  - free-text notes
  metadata_pass:
  - PIL re-encode all PNGs
  - clear SVG generator tags
  - strip source path from <title>/meta
  - no external CDN fetch
  serialized_pass:
  - no row-level dumps
  - no dataframe in JS/JSON
  - aggregates typed as literals in the HTML
edit_levers:
- titles/labels
- threshold
- N in top-N
- which dims
- rounding
- chart palette


```
